translations.web: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.
translations.bsb: I will drive him like a peg into a firm place, and he will be a throne of glory for the house of his father.
translations.kjv: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's house.
